steps.observation: You have 10 seconds. Explain the difference between RNA and DNA.

steps.action:
DNA  
• Sugar: deoxyribose (missing one oxygen)  
• Bases: A, T, C, G  
• Structure: usually double-stranded helix  
• Role: long-term genetic storage in nucleus (and mitochondria)  
• Stability: very stable

RNA  
• Sugar: ribose (one more oxygen)  
• Bases: A, U, C, G (uracil replaces thymine)  
• Structure: usually single-stranded, varied shapes  
• Role: working copies—mRNA, tRNA, rRNA, etc.—for protein synthesis & regulation  
• Stability: less stable, rapidly degraded
